title: List select on task forms, list links on the list page, lists e2e
description:

- Component tests: task-fields.test.tsx gains the List control cases (options, default from values.listId, error alert).
- Docs: how/lists.md gains the select and the row link (entry points + mechanism); how/tasks.md's form tables gain the List row; scheduling.md untouched; _overview.md date line; README "What it is" mentions lists if it lists capabilities.
Files likely touched: src/app/components/task-fields.tsx + test, add-task-form.tsx, edit-task-form.tsx, task-list.tsx, task-page.tsx, src/app/tasks/[id]/edit/{page,actions}.ts(x), src/app/actions.ts, e2e/lists.spec.ts (new), docs/current/how/lists.md, docs/current/how/tasks.md, docs/current/_overview.md, docs/current/README.md.
